assumptions.choice: base_price defaults to 100.0 and main_shares defaults to 100 as placeholder bt.Strategy params
assumptions.reason: spec states these are passed in as parameters but gives no numeric default; placeholders avoid a crash if the harness omits them, and are expected to be overridden via addstrategy kwargs

assumptions.choice: the core long position is never bought/sold by this strategy; base_price and main_shares are used only as inputs to the hedge sizing and threshold formulas
assumptions.reason: spec explicitly states the hedge is modeled as a separate account/strategy that does not touch the underlying long

assumptions.choice: price_stop breach and roll-threshold breaches are evaluated against bar Close, matching the explicitly stated Close-based take-profit rule
assumptions.reason: spec only gives an explicit Close-based formula for the take-profit; applying the same Close-based convention to the stop and to threshold breaches keeps evaluation consistent since no intrabar (High/Low) rule is stated

assumptions.choice: a roll is executed as a close order followed, once that close is Completed (in notify_order), by a fresh sell order; the two fills land on different bars
assumptions.reason: canonical default requires guarding pending orders one at a time, so a true same-bar close+reopen is not possible; this is the closest literal execution under that constraint

assumptions.choice: if floor(0.02*main_shares*Close/ATR) < 1, no open or roll-reopen order is submitted that bar
assumptions.reason: spec gives no minimum size rule, but an order of size 0 or less is not meaningful in backtrader

assumptions.topic: multiple threshold levels crossed in one bar
assumptions.choice: a gap that crosses several 0.10*k increments in a single bar is treated as one new-breach/roll event up to the highest k reached, tracked via a running highest_k counter
assumptions.reason: only one order can be actioned per bar under the pending-order guard, and the spec's 'has not been reached before' wording is naturally satisfied by tracking the maximum threshold ever reached

assumptions.choice: when multiple exit conditions coincide on the same bar for an open hedge, priority is stop-loss, then take-profit, then expiry, then roll-breach
assumptions.reason: spec lists these rules independently without stating precedence for simultaneous triggers
